tips_en: Read the Stable GDN-2 paper first: it offers a crisp diagnosis-and-fix cycle (asymmetric erasure causing recurrent-state blow-up, replaced by symmetric erasure plus decay-regulated residual writes) with a provable O(sqrt(T)) state bound and a 6.80-point 128K RULER gain, making it the most directly reusable insight. Next, read OS-Omni for the broadest survey of long-horizon agent evaluation (cross-platform, live, final-state checks, frontier models still 8.8 points below the human reference), and treat VibeVideoAgent as its domain-specific counterpart, applying the same audit-style verification to audiovisual artifacts. All three share one theme — keeping state coherent over long horizons without silent divergence, whether in a model's recurrent memory, an OS session's persistent application state, or a rendered video's timeline and audio-visual synchronization.
tips_zh: 建议先读 Stable GDN-2：它给出最紧凑的「诊断—修复」闭环（把 GDN-2 的状态爆炸归因于不对称擦除，改用对称擦除加衰减调节的残差写入），并证明 O(√T) 状态界、128K RULER 提升 6.80 分，结论最具可迁移性。其次读 OS-Omni，纵览长时程智能体的评测图景（跨平台、实时执行、终态校验，前沿模型仍落后人类 8.8 分）；再读 VibeVideoAgent，把它视为面向视听产物的同类实践——用同样严格的审计式验证替代事后返工。 三篇论文共享同一主题：在长时程任务中让状态保持一致而不发生隐性偏离，无论体现在模型的循环记忆、操作系统会话的持久应用状态，还是视频时间线与音画同步之中。
